mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' profitability improves.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 6-month MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth rate < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 12-month moving average, the tightening monetary policy and rising inflation expectations lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bps in a quarter and CPIAUCSL > 12-month MA
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the unemployment rate (UNRATE) being below the historical average (around 5.5%) is indicative of a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as consumer spending remains robust.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and consumer spending
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when UNRATE < 5.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the annual growth rate of real disposable personal income (RSAFS) exceeds 4% and the housing starts (HOUST) are above 1200 units, the strong demand indicators lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as both consumer and housing sectors drive economic growth.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS annual growth rate > 4% and HOUST > 1200
evidence_refs: fact:historical demand indicators and GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
